name: The Moon-Tide Debt
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: encyclopedia cover illustration for Avarenne, a mature late-industrial occult fantasy novel. Scene: Stone ritual cistern under moonlight, one narrow invested silver rim with three separate crescent-like seals, covered dangerous contact section and an ordinary water dipper kept clear, black water reflecting the real moon, no erotic imagery or transforming person. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, tactile architecture and believable materials, dramatic but readable light, atmospheric depth. One coherent scene, landscape 3:2. Show only the specified bounded manifestation; supernatural graphic traces are illustrative, never game interface. Anonymous adult figures only when specified, no named canonical character. No legible text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, card frame or collage. No additional creature, portal, deity, avatar or city-wide catastrophe. Avoid exaggerating the effect beyond its local source.
visual_caption: Il bordo investito conserva un ciclo predisposto: la luna riflessa non è la sua riserva. Ricostruzione illustrativa, non prova diagnostica o fonte di nuove capacità. La scena mostra un esercizio possibile alle condizioni indicate, non un’attivazione già in corso al T0.
visual_review: APPROVATA: scena, limiti illustrativi e assenza di poteri aggiuntivi verificati
